args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the weekly case unconditionally advances by 7 days without checking whether `next <= from` first (unlike daily), so a weekly schedule created on Monday before 06:00 UTC gets its next run scheduled for a week later rather than later that same day. Add the same check as daily (`if (next <= from) next.setUTCDate(next.getUTCDate() + 7);`) so weekly exports created before the run hour go out on their first day.
args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export missing the first day when created early
